description.zh: 中世纪村庄集市，摆有木制摊位、长凳、木桶和粮食麻袋。可交互物体：篮筐。
description.en: A medieval village market with wooden stalls, benches, barrels and grain sacks. Interactive object: basket.

description.zh: 中世纪风车庭院，旁边有塔楼、木推车和工坊物料。无可交互物体。
description.en: A medieval windmill courtyard with a tower, wooden cart and workshop supplies. No interactive objects.
